status: G5 first batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-debris-roman, in Chapter XII (the desktop app only)
use: The field after a victory: what beaten Roman troops leave beside their fallen, on the walked field (the rival Romans of Chapter XII, and the Romans who fell in Chapter VI's retreat).

generator.prompt: Battlefield debris of beaten Roman soldiers lying flat on the ground: two curved oval red shields with bronze bosses, one split, a broken pilum, a short sword in its scabbard and a dropped iron helmet with cheek guards, scattered over about two metres; nothing stands more than twenty-five centimetres high. Faded red paint, bronze, dark iron and leather. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

review.scope: Tripo's own render, four views of the final compressed model with a 1.8 m figure for scale (scripts/assets/preview-model.mjs), and the battles in the desktop build at High
review.notes: Red shields with bronze bosses and rims lying flat, one split, swords, a broken pilum and an iron helmet. Its shields came round rather than oval, which suits the third century's Roman shields; its helmet is a closed cavalry-style helmet. Processed at 0.34 m high (the helmet stands highest) for a spread of 1.36 by 1.12 m. The request's chapters were corrected to Chapter XII alone, the only battle against Romans.
